evidenceCues: Maximum reported length is 10.5 cm total length.
The body is compressed and disc-shaped, silvery with four dark bars in adults rather than seven juvenile bars.

evidenceCues: Cross section is compressed, dorsal head profile is clearly concave, and the mouth is terminal.
SL/body height at the anal level is 1.07 to 1.29.
Dorsal and anal spiny rays increase posteriorly and the first branched rays are very long.

referenceGradeRationale: Authoritative morphology and exact adult lateral imagery strongly constrain the diagnostic side profile and pattern. True top and front coverage is unavailable, so width remains an explicit inference.
